Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional urban farming platform called GreenGrid. Its Web App lets growers log plots. The Web App calls the API Service for every read and write. The API Service stores plot and harvest records in the Farms DB. When a harvest is logged, events flow from the API Service to the Message Queue. From the Message Queue they flow to the Notification Worker, which emails subscribers. A Scheduler Service runs nightly jobs and writes summaries into the Farms DB.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional library lending system called BookHive. Patrons use the Mobile App to search and reserve books. The Mobile App talks to the Gateway API over HTTPS. The Gateway API queries the Catalog DB for book details. Reservations are written by the Gateway API into the Loans DB. When a due date nears, a Reminder Worker reads the Loans DB and sends notices to the Message Queue, which delivers them to the Mobile App.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional clinic scheduling system called CarePath. Patients book visits through the Web Portal. The Web Portal sends requests to the Booking Service. The Booking Service checks clinician availability in the Schedule DB and writes confirmed visits to the Visits DB. Every booking triggers a message published to the Event Bus. An SMS Worker consumes messages from the Event Bus and texts patients. A Reporting Service queries the Visits DB each night to build dashboards.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional delivery platform called RouteWise. Dispatchers work in the Dispatch Console. The Dispatch Console calls the Routing API to plan trips. The Routing API stores routes in the Routes DB and driver status in the Fleet DB. Finished routes are pushed by the Routing API onto the Task Queue. A Driver App pulls assigned stops from the Task Queue. The Routing API also queries the Map Tile Service for distance data along each route.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional online course platform called SkillForge. Learners browse courses in the Web App. The Web App queries the Course Service for catalog data. The Course Service reads lesson metadata from the Content DB. Video files are streamed by the Media Service directly to the Web App. When a learner finishes a lesson, the Course Service emits a completion event to the Analytics Queue. A Progress Worker reads from the Analytics Queue and updates learner streaks in the Content DB.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional expense tracking tool called LedgerLite. Employees submit receipts in the Mobile Client. The Mobile Client uploads them to the Upload Gateway. The Upload Gateway stores files in the Receipt Store and writes rows to the Ledger DB. An OCR Worker pulls new rows from the Ledger DB, extracts amounts, and publishes results to the Result Queue. A Sync Service consumes the Result Queue and pushes extracted values back to the Mobile Client.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional solar monitoring system called GridWatch. Field probes send readings to the Ingest Service. The Ingest Service validates them and writes to the Readings DB. The Ingest Service also forwards anomalous readings to the Alert Queue. An Alert Worker drains the Alert Queue and calls the Notification API. A Dashboard Web App queries the Readings DB for charts. The Notification API sends emails through the Mail Relay whenever an anomaly is confirmed.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional employee feedback platform called TeamPulse. Managers open the Admin Portal to launch surveys. The Admin Portal sends survey definitions to the Survey Service. The Survey Service persists them in the Survey DB. Employees answer through the Mobile App, which posts responses to the Survey Service. The Survey Service aggregates results and writes them to the Analytics DB. A Report Generator reads the Analytics DB and builds PDF summaries shown in the Admin Portal.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional trip planning tool called TripNest. Travelers build itineraries in the Web Client. The Web Client calls the Itinerary Service. The Itinerary Service stores trips in the Trips DB. For prices, the Itinerary Service queries the Pricing API. The Pricing API caches fares in the Fare Cache. A Price Watch Worker reads the Trips DB and pushes fare alerts to the Alert Service, which then notifies the Web Client directly.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional community news app called BriefWire. Readers browse stories in the Mobile Reader. The Mobile Reader fetches content from the Content API. The Content API reads articles from the Article DB and images from the Asset Store. Editors publish through the Editor Console, which writes drafts into the Article DB. When a story goes live, the Content API emits an event to the Publish Queue, and a Push Worker delivers notifications from the Publish Queue to the Mobile Reader.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional restaurant ordering system called TableTide. Diners order from the Kiosk App. The Kiosk App sends orders to the Order Service. The Order Service validates items against the Menu DB and writes orders to the Kitchen DB. A Kitchen Screen polls the Kitchen DB for live tickets. When an order is paid, the Order Service publishes a receipt to the Billing Queue. A Billing Worker drains the Billing Queue and settles each payment record.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional fitness tracking service called PulseTrack. Athletes record workouts in the Wearable Sync App. The Wearable Sync App uploads sessions to the Ingest API. The Ingest API writes raw sessions to the Session Store and emits events to the Metrics Queue. A Metrics Worker consumes the Metrics Queue and computes totals into the Metrics DB. A Coach Dashboard reads the Metrics DB to show weekly progress across all tracked athletes and teams.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional veterinary clinic management system called PawClinic. Pet owners use a Mobile App to book visits, view vaccination records and upload X-ray photos. The Mobile App talks to a Clinic API Service over HTTPS. The Clinic API Service stores appointments, clients and medical notes in a Clinic DB, and writes uploaded images to an Object Store. Whenever an appointment is booked or changed, the Clinic API Service publishes an event to a Message Queue. A Reminder Worker consumes those events from the Message Queue and sends vaccination and visit reminders to owners.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional podcast hosting platform called AirCast. Creators upload episodes through a Creator Studio, a web application, while listeners stream audio from a Listener App. Both the Creator Studio and the Listener App call a Media API Service over HTTPS. The Media API Service stores show and episode metadata in a Catalog DB and writes audio files to a Media Bucket. After an upload finishes, the Media API Service enqueues a transcoding job on a Job Queue. A Transcoding Worker picks up jobs from the Job Queue and converts each episode into several bitrates before writing them back to the Media Bucket.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional city parking reservation system called SpotLock. Drivers use a Parking Mobile App to find and reserve spaces, and garage operators use an Operator Dashboard. Both connect to a Reservation API Service. The Reservation API Service keeps parking spots, reservations and payments in a Parking DB. When a reservation is confirmed, the Reservation API Service sends a message to an Access Queue. A Gate Controller Worker reads from the Access Queue and opens the garage barrier for the driver's license plate. A Pricing Service reads occupancy from the Parking DB and updates hourly rates.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional home security monitoring service called SafeHearth. Homeowners arm and disarm their systems with a Homeowner App, and the security sensors in each house report motion directly to an Ingest Service. The Homeowner App also calls the Ingest Service to fetch recent events. The Ingest Service writes all sensor events to a Security DB and forwards urgent alerts to an Alert Topic. A Monitoring Worker consumes the Alert Topic and notifies an on-call operator through a Notifications Service. When an operator escalates, the Notifications Service pages the homeowner's phone.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional freelance marketplace called CraftBridge. Clients post projects through a Client Portal and freelancers browse and bid using a Freelancer App. Both front ends call a Marketplace API Service. The Marketplace API Service keeps profiles, projects and bids in a Marketplace DB. When a contract is awarded, the Marketplace API Service writes a payout request to a Payout Queue. A Payments Worker consumes payout requests from the Payout Queue and transfers funds through a Bank Gateway. The Payments Worker then records each completed transfer back in the Marketplace DB.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional museum ticketing system called HallOfWonders. Visitors buy timed-entry tickets on a Ticket Website and scan them at the door with a Gate Scanner App. Both talk to a Ticketing API Service. The Ticketing API Service records tickets, members and scans in a Ticketing DB. When a ticket is scanned, the Ticketing API Service publishes a check-in event to an Event Stream. A Capacity Monitor reads the Event Stream and recalculates the remaining capacity for each gallery. The Capacity Monitor posts a warning to staff whenever a gallery nears its limit.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional food bank inventory system called HarvestShare. Partner agencies order supplies through an Agency Portal, and warehouse volunteers update stock on a Warehouse Tablet App. Both call an Inventory API Service over HTTPS. The Inventory API Service stores donations, stock levels and orders in an Inventory DB. When stock falls below a threshold, the Inventory API Service posts a low-stock alert to a Restock Queue. A Restock Worker consumes those alerts from the Restock Queue and emails the purchasing volunteers. A Reporting Service reads the Inventory DB nightly and builds distribution summaries.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional car sharing service called ZipRide. Members find and unlock cars with a Rider App, while fleet staff manage vehicles through a Fleet Console. Both connect to a Sharing API Service. The Sharing API Service keeps members, vehicles and trips in a Fleet DB and publishes unlock commands to a Command Queue. A Vehicle Gateway Worker consumes commands from the Command Queue and signals the car's telematics unit. When a trip ends, the Vehicle Gateway Worker reports mileage back to the Sharing API Service, which records the trip in the Fleet DB.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional co-working space booking system called DeskHive. Members reserve desks and meeting rooms through a Member App, and front-desk staff manage check-ins on a Reception Console. Both call a Booking API Service. The Booking API Service stores members, desks, rooms and reservations in a Booking DB. When a reservation is created, the Booking API Service pushes a confirmation event to a Notify Queue. A Notify Worker reads the Notify Queue and sends calendar invitations and door codes. A Usage Analytics Service reads the Booking DB hourly to report desk occupancy per floor.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional language learning platform called LinguaLoop. Learners practice on a Mobile Lesson App, and teachers build and grade exercises in a Teacher Studio. Both call a Learning API Service. The Learning API Service stores courses, exercises and learner progress in a Learning DB, and writes practice audio to a Voice Bucket. When a learner submits a spoken answer, the Learning API Service adds a grading task to a Grading Queue. A Speech Grading Worker consumes tasks from the Grading Queue, scores pronunciation, and saves results back through the Learning API Service.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional pet adoption platform called SecondChancePets. Shelters list animals through a Shelter Console, and adopters browse and apply using an Adopter App. Both call an Adoption API Service. The Adoption API Service keeps animal profiles, shelter records and applications in an Adoption DB, and stores animal photos in a Photo Store. When an application is approved, the Adoption API Service writes a match event to a Match Topic. A Match Notifier reads the Match Topic and sends congratulations messages to both the shelter and the adopter.

Draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid for this system:

A fictional bicycle repair dispatch service called PedalFix. Cyclists request repairs through a Rider App, and mechanics accept and close jobs on a Mechanic App. Both call a Dispatch API Service. The Dispatch API Service keeps riders, mechanics and jobs in a Dispatch DB and tracks each mechanic's live location in a Geo Index. When a new request arrives, the Dispatch API Service sends a job offer to an Offer Queue. A Matching Worker reads offers from the Offer Queue and assigns the nearest available mechanic through the Dispatch API Service.
